## Summary

Ordering is TDD-first inside each feature (Hybrid strategy: TDD for probe/at-risk/nudge/commit logic on fake ports; lightweight for guidance, wiring, docs). Fakes only in CI; the live-daemon replay is a local manual verification task. Repo guardrails: never git add -A; explicit pathspecs; HARNESS_NO_TELEMETRY=1 prefix + timeout 30 git commit --no-verify for own commits; never link global harness; never touch government/, the-flow files, refs/harness-telemetry/*. 073 surface additive-only.
